STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_124320.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_124320.v · Open raw
module origen_124320 (
    input wire i_Clk,
    input wire i_RX_Serial,
    input wire i_TX_Load,
    input wire [7:0] i_TX_Byte,
    output reg o_RX_Done,
    output reg [7:0] o_RX_Byte,
    output reg o_TX_Active,
    output reg o_TX_Serial,
    output reg o_TX_Done
);

    // Parameters
    parameter CLKS_PER_BIT = 87; // Assuming 115200 baud rate with 10MHz clock
    parameter IDLE = 2'b00;
    parameter START = 2'b01;
    parameter DATA = 2'b10;
    parameter STOP = 2'b11;

    // RX registers
    reg [1:0] r_RX_State = IDLE;
    reg [7:0] r_RX_Data = 8'h00;
    reg [7:0] r_Clock_Count = 0;
    reg [2:0] r_Bit_Index = 0;

    // TX registers
    reg [1:0] r_TX_State = IDLE;
    reg [7:0] r_TX_Data = 8'h00;
    reg [7:0] r_Clock_Count_TX = 0;
    reg [2:0] r_Bit_Index_TX = 0;

    // RX logic
    always @(posedge i_Clk) begin
        case (r_RX_State)
            IDLE: begin
                o_RX_Done <= 1'b0;
                r_Clock_Count <= 0;
                r_Bit_Index <= 0;

                if (i_RX_Serial == 1'b0)
                    r_RX_State <= START;
                else
                    r_RX_State <= IDLE;
            end

            START: begin
                if (r_Clock_Count == (CLKS_PER_BIT - 1) / 2) begin
                    if (i_RX_Serial == 1'b0) begin
                        r_Clock_Count <= 0;
                        r_RX_State <= DATA;
                    end else
                        r_RX_State <= IDLE;
                end else begin
                    r_Clock_Count <= r_Clock_Count + 1;
                    r_RX_State <= START;
                end
            end

            DATA: begin
                if (r_Clock_Count < CLKS_PER_BIT - 1) begin
                    r_Clock_Count <= r_Clock_Count + 1;
                    r_RX_State <= DATA;
                end else begin
                    r_Clock_Count <= 0;
                    r_RX_Data[r_Bit_Index] <= i_RX_Serial;

                    if (r_Bit_Index < 7) begin
                        r_Bit_Index <= r_Bit_Index + 1;
                        r_RX_State <= DATA;
                    end else begin
                        r_Bit_Index <= 0;
                        r_RX_State <= STOP;
                    end
                end
            end

            STOP: begin
                if (r_Clock_Count < CLKS_PER_BIT - 1) begin
                    r_Clock_Count <= r_Clock_Count + 1;
                    r_RX_State <= STOP;
                end else begin
                    o_RX_Done <= 1'b1;
                    o_RX_Byte <= r_RX_Data;
                    r_Clock_Count <= 0;
                    r_RX_State <= IDLE;
                end
            end

            default:
                r_RX_State <= IDLE;
        endcase
    end

    // TX logic
    always @(posedge i_Clk) begin
        case (r_TX_State)
            IDLE: begin
                o_TX_Serial <= 1'b1;
                o_TX_Done <= 1'b0;
                r_Clock_Count_TX <= 0;
                r_Bit_Index_TX <= 0;

                if (i_TX_Load) begin
                    r_TX_Data <= i_TX_Byte;
                    r_TX_State <= START;
                end else
                    r_TX_State <= IDLE;
            end

            START: begin
                o_TX_Active <= 1'b1;
                o_TX_Serial <= 1'b0;

                if (r_Clock_Count_TX < CLKS_PER_BIT - 1) begin
                    r_Clock_Count_TX <= r_Clock_Count_TX + 1;
                    r_TX_State <= START;
                end else begin
                    r_Clock_Count_TX <= 0;
                    r_TX_State <= DATA;
                end
            end

            DATA: begin
                o_TX_Serial <= r_TX_Data[r_Bit_Index_TX];

                if (r_Clock_Count_TX < CLKS_PER_BIT - 1) begin
                    r_Clock_Count_TX <= r_Clock_Count_TX + 1;
                    r_TX_State <= DATA;
                end else begin
                    r_Clock_Count_TX <= 0;

                    if (r_Bit_Index_TX < 7) begin
                        r_Bit_Index_TX <= r_Bit_Index_TX + 1;
                        r_TX_State <= DATA;
                    end else begin
                        r_Bit_Index_TX <= 0;
                        r_TX_State <= STOP;
                    end
                end
            end

            STOP: begin
                o_TX_Serial <= 1'b1;

                if (r_Clock_Count_TX < CLKS_PER_BIT - 1) begin
                    r_Clock_Count_TX <= r_Clock_Count_TX + 1;
                    r_TX_State <= STOP;
                end else begin
                    o_TX_Done <= 1'b1;
                    o_TX_Active <= 1'b0;
                    r_Clock_Count_TX <= 0;
                    r_TX_State <= IDLE;
                end
            end

            default:
                r_TX_State <= IDLE;
        endcase
    end

endmodule
